prose: Sarthak Rastogi presents agent-engineer, a free open-source plugin for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode and Gemini CLI with 11 skills, 4 subagents and 5 hooks covering tools, prompting, context, RAG, evals, tracing, guardrails and production. In a blinded A/B test on 6 agent tasks, Claude Code with Opus 5.5 met 53% of requirements with the plugin against 34% without. The post also shows an example where the plugin refuses to claim improvement without running real evaluations.
highlights: Open-source plugin with 11 skills, 4 subagents and 5 hooks.
Blinded test: 53% of requirements met with it, 34% without (6 tasks, author's own test).
Warns when changes are unevaluated instead of claiming improvement.
